REGISTERED BY THE TAVAREKERE POLICE STATION,
MAGADI CIRCLE, RAMANAGAR DATED 13.08.2015 IN CR.NO.592/2015 AND SPLIT UP CHARGE SHEET IN C.C.NO.4242/2017 BEFORE THE CJM, BANGALORE RURAL DISTRICT BANGALORE ON THE COMPLAINT LODGED AGAINST THE PETITIONER FOR THE OFFENCES ALLEGED TO HAVE BEEN COMMITTED BY THE PETITIONER ACCUSED NO.5 UNDER SECTION 498A, 323, 504, 506, 134 OF IPC R/W 3, 4 OF D.P ACT.
 THIS CRIMINAL PETITION COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned counsel for petitioner seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the petition stating that parties have settled the dispute themselves amicably.
2. Submission is placed on record.
Hence, Criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Pending I.As., if any, do not survive for consideration in view of the disposal of the main petition.
